chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about madhy getting onto a garment. He said: “There is no harm in it.” Then when we repeated the question to him, he said: “Sprinkle it with water.”

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the fluid
key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid referred to in the ruling
key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, as the instructed method of treatment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; an expression indicating no problem

ai.seo_question: What should be done if madhy gets on one’s clothing according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning madhy when it reaches clothing. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام first states that there is no harm in it, then instructs that the garment be sprinkled with water, indicating a practical ruling related to ritual purity.
